answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 28487 Country: India Title: I WANT TO KNOW THAT WHEN A GIRL HAS HER PERIODS DURING RAMZAANS DEN SHE CAN READ QURAN , NAMAZ, OR CAN DO TILAWAT IN HAJ OR NOT? Question: DEAR SIR ASSALAM O ALIKUM... SIR I WANT TO KNOW THAT WHEN A GIRL HAS HER PERIODS DURING RAMZAANS DEN SHE CAN READ QURAN , NAMAZ, OR CAN DO TILAWAT IN HAJ OR NOT??? SHADAB------- Answer ID: 28487 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 104/86/H=1432) She neither can recite the holy Quran nor keep fast. And the recitation and sawm carry the same rulings during Hajj as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
